fields.description: Before summoning, linked source Actor HP is a configuration preview. During a live summon, the exact placed token Actor supplies HP and disables this input. At zero HP or removal its HP arc hides and saved defaults return.

fields.label: Maximum HP
fields.description: Live HP arc capacity comes from the active summoned token Actor’s maximum HP. Before summoning, a valid linked Actor supplies a preview; otherwise the configured default is used. Editing this field does not edit a live token.

fields.label: Resource display
fields.description: Choose X/Y counter, up-to-three usage dots or Fang percentage. This is the companion’s separate pool, not shared SP.

fields.label: Current resource
fields.description: Live companion resource available for its abilities. Restore resource refills it to the configured maximum.

fields.label: Maximum resource
fields.description: Capacity of the companion’s pool. Dots use up to 3, percentage up to 100 and the counter supports a larger maximum.

fields.label: Ability name
fields.description: Label of this companion ability’s use button and chat presentation.

fields.label: Ability description

fields.label: Damage formula
fields.description: Optional supported dice formula for the companion ability. It is separate from the resource cost and description.

fields.label: Resource cost
fields.description: Amount of this companion’s own resource needed to use the ability. It is not the summoner’s shared SP cost.

fields.label: Ability icon
fields.description: Artwork for this individual companion ability button. A blank image uses the addon’s ordinary fallback.

fields.label: Show bottom HUD name

fields.label: Hide summoner Talent

fields.label: Floating summon button

fields.label: Show portrait
fields.description: Show the companion’s circular portrait region. Other HP/resource visibility switches remain separate.

fields.label: Show HP arc
fields.description: Display the companion’s semicircular HP bar in its applicable summoned state, based on companion HP rather than the summoner’s Energy.

fields.description: Base companion HUD frame width in pixels. Whole-frame scale is applied separately.

fields.label: Target
fields.description: Creature receiving this DoT or tracked condition. Damage ticks at that creature’s turn start.

fields.label: Source
fields.description: Actor whose eligible Light Cone modifiers apply. No source uses base damage only.

fields.label: DoT type
fields.description: Rule identity such as Burn, Shock, Bleed or Wind Shear. It is independent of the damage attribute used for resistance.

fields.label: Damage attribute
fields.description: Damage type used for resistance and immunity processing. This does not itself identify the cone’s DoT classification.

fields.label: Dice count
fields.description: Number of base damage dice rolled per future DoT tick. Source cone upgrades are applied when a tick rolls.

fields.label: Die size
fields.description: Base die faces for each recurring damage die. This is a die size, not a flat damage bonus.

fields.label: Turn count
fields.description: Number of future ticks/turns for the assigned effect. The DoT clears after its final tick.

fields.label: Tracked condition
fields.description: Choose reduced AC, slowed, implanted weakness or other debuff. This condition action is separate from Apply DoT.

fields.label: Penalty magnitude
fields.description: Whole amount of the selected tracked condition’s penalty. Target and duration come from their shared fields.

fields.label: Multitype?
fields.description: Enable an alternate Element system for this specific Actor, including PCs, NPCs and summoned creatures on every Path. ON reveals the mode switch. OFF uses the Actor’s current Assigned Element for future attacks, retaining saved Item/activity assignments and the last selected Actor Element. This GM control saves immediately.

fields.label: Multitype attacks / Type Changer
fields.description: OFF selects Multitype attacks: activities and Items may choose independent HSR Elements, with the Actor Element as fallback. ON selects Type Changer: the GM switches the entire Actor’s current Element, and saved attack overrides are inactive. The selected mode’s label is emphasized. Saves immediately; switching keeps the other mode’s assignments.

fields.label: Assigned Element
fields.description: This specific Actor’s current HSR Element, used by ordinary attacks and unassigned attacks. Define choices in the Element Manager. In Type Changer, live changes update this same value. None removes its HSR Element. Saves immediately without changing Path, weakness definitions, charge or D&D5e damage types.

fields.label: Initiative portrait
fields.description: Browse or drop an accessible image path for this tracker portrait. Empty uses the source Actor portrait in the normal form, or normal artwork in the enhanced form. Changes save automatically. NPCs share this value through their source Actor, independently for normal and enhanced framing.

fields.label: Horizontal position
fields.description: Move the artwork horizontally as a percentage of the initiative card width. 50 centers it; 0 is a valid offset. Larger zoom values allow additional travel. Changes save automatically. NPCs share this value through their source Actor, independently for normal and enhanced framing.

fields.label: Vertical position
fields.description: Move the artwork vertically as a percentage of the initiative card height. 50 centers it. Drag the preview for visual placement. Changes save automatically. NPCs share this value through their source Actor, independently for normal and enhanced framing.

fields.label: Portrait zoom
fields.description: Set image zoom as a percentage: 100 is its normal contained size. Scroll over the preview to adjust by five percentage points. Changes save automatically. NPCs share this value through their source Actor, independently for normal and enhanced framing.

fields.label: Flip portrait
fields.description: Mirror the tracker portrait horizontally. This changes the artwork presentation and does not change token facing or map artwork. Changes save automatically. NPCs share this value through their source Actor, independently for normal and enhanced framing.

rules.description: Open this related group of character controls. Choosing a category while searching narrows the search scope to that menu.

rules.description: Enable this ability’s Actor choice and placement workflow. Skill and Ultimate summon lists are separate.

rules.label: Summoning radius
rules.description: Maximum placement range in scene distance units. With lighting walls or surfaces present, the entire creature must fit inside the range and scene. On open maps without those boundaries, only the selected square must be in range and on the map. The full creature always needs unoccupied space.

rules.label: Creature count
rules.description: How many copies of this creature choice the cast places. Each copy needs a legal complete footprint.

rules.label: Activation mode

rules.label: Alternate orb label
rules.description: Name of this custom charge configuration shown in its GM controls. It does not rename the Actor.

rules.label: Starting icon
rules.description: Component that lights first in circular mode. The sequence proceeds from it by unique Sequence order and wraps at the end.

rules.label: First activation number
rules.description: Counter value that lights the first icon. With four components and a start number of 2, values 0–1 light none and 5 lights all four.

rules.label: Active component glow
rules.description: Enable the overall glow around active components. A component’s own glow switch and color also apply.

rules.label: Component name
rules.description: Human-readable label for this individual icon and its free activation checkbox.

rules.label: Active image
rules.description: Artwork displayed when the component is on. Transparent pixels preserve the uploaded icon shape.

rules.label: Off image
rules.description: Optional inactive artwork. When blank, the active image is greyed out. An uploaded off image keeps its own appearance.

rules.label: Component X
rules.description: Horizontal component center as a percentage of the orb canvas. This is display position, not a map coordinate.

rules.label: Component Y
rules.description: Vertical component center as a percentage of the orb canvas. This does not change activation order.

rules.label: Component scale
rules.description: Visual size as a percentage of the designer canvas baseline. Use drag handles or the mouse wheel to adjust.

rules.label: Component rotation
rules.description: Visual angle in degrees. This rotates artwork and does not change its circular charge Sequence order.

rules.label: Component glow color
rules.description: Color used for this active component’s glow. Detect image color can initialize it; you can override black, white or another detected color.

rules.label: Glow when active
rules.description: Allow this component to glow while it is lit. The overall active-glow setting must also be enabled.

rules.label: Sequence order
rules.description: Unique circular charging order. The selected Starting icon begins the route; layer order controls drawing on top separately.

rules.label: Add component
rules.description: Create a new editable component in the draft orb design.

rules.label: Upload component images
rules.description: Choose images to upload as components through Foundry storage. Configure each component’s placement and glow afterward.

rules.label: Browse artwork
rules.description: Choose artwork for this image slot using Foundry storage. Other component slots remain separate.

rules.label: Save orb design
rules.description: Commit this form’s draft layout, art and charge configuration. Previewing All on/off does not alter live counters.

rules.label: Delete component
rules.description: Remove the selected component from the draft design. The uploaded image file itself is not deleted.

rules.label: Duplicate component
rules.description: Copy the selected component’s design so its placement and other properties can be edited independently.

rules.label: Raise component layer
rules.description: Move this component toward the top drawing layer. This does not change circular Sequence order.

rules.label: Lower component layer
rules.description: Move this component behind other drawing layers without changing circular Sequence order.

rules.label: Select component
rules.description: Select this component for editing. Selection alone does not light its live activation counter.

rules.label: Detect image color
rules.description: Analyze the selected image’s main color as a starting glow color. The saved color can still be edited manually.

rules.label: Make starting icon
rules.description: Choose the selected component as the first icon in circular mode. First activation number still controls the initial counter offset.

rules.label: Live component activation
rules.description: GM switch for this component in free mode. On lights it; all components must be on before the Ultimate can cast.

rules.label: Live circular charge
rules.description: Current cumulative circular counter. Each increment lights the next configured component and keeps earlier ones lit.

rules.label: Reset alternate counters
rules.description: Clear live alternate progress for this form. The saved layout, images and activation mode remain.

rules.label: Edit alternate orb
rules.description: Open this Actor’s active-form orb designer. Editing the layout is separate from changing live counters.

rules.label: Component canvas object
rules.description: Drag to move this selected component in the orb canvas. Use its handles for size/rotation; this preview is not a live cast.

rules.label: Component transform handle
rules.description: Drag to resize or rotate the selected component. This changes its visual design rather than its activation progress.

rules.label: Preview all inactive
rules.description: Show every draft component off without changing live progress.

rules.label: Preview all active
rules.description: Show every draft component lit with its configured glow. Live GM counters remain unchanged.

rules.label: Preview live counters
rules.description: Display the Actor’s actual saved counters in the draft layout. The preview does not cast or consume them.

rules.label: Ability row preview

rules.label: Open portrait editor
rules.description: Open the circular companion crop designer. Save Portrait applies its image/crop separately from the tab icon.

rules.label: Restore companion resource
rules.description: Refill the companion’s current resource to its configured maximum. This is a live value change, not a preview.

rules.label: Add companion ability

rules.label: Remove companion ability
rules.description: Remove this entry from the companion kit without deleting the source Actor or other abilities.

rules.label: Use companion ability
rules.description: Activate this companion ability through its normal resource check and chat/roll workflow. This spends its companion cost, not shared SP.

rules.label: Show summon launcher

rules.label: Preview summoned
rules.description: Show a summoned-state sample for designing HP/resources. This does not summon a map token or add initiative.

rules.label: Linked companion source

rules.label: Choose companion artwork

rules.label: No weaknesses

rules.description: Set the exact live party-wide balance. This changes a resource immediately; a character’s configured ability cost is separate.

rules.label: Temporary weakness selection

rules.label: Immediate Energy override
rules.description: Value to apply with Set Energy. This changes current Energy only and retains active alternate/round-lock charge rules.

rules.label: Apply DoT
rules.description: Create the selected recurring damage on the target using these source, dice, attribute and duration fields. This is a live encounter change.

rules.label: Assign tracked condition
rules.description: Apply the selected condition/magnitude using the current Target and Turn count. This is not an immediate DoT damage roll.

rules.label: Remaining ticks
rules.description: Change this existing effect’s future tick count. It clears after the final tick; this is a live duration edit.

rules.label: Remove DoT
rules.description: Remove this existing recurring damage effect from its target. Its past applied damage is not undone.

rules.label: Remove condition
rules.description: Clear this tracked condition, not the creature’s unrelated effects or permanent sheet fields.

rules.label: Ability classification
rules.description: Classify this ability for supported Light Cone event rules. This is separate from editing its descriptive name.

rules.label: Light Cone counter
rules.description: Stored stack/progress for this Actor’s eligible cone. Cooldown counters can record the Actor turn when a trigger last happened.

rules.label: Adjusted combat value
rules.description: Editable effective value for this encounter. Automatic shows the derived baseline before manual changes; this is tracked separately from permanent sheet data.

rules.label: Effective critical threshold
rules.description: Lowest d20 result that critically hits after supported sheet/equipment/Planar bonuses. More critical rate lowers this threshold.

rules.label: Critical damage bonus
rules.description: Additive critical damage benefit. It is distinct from critical threshold and from the base damage dice.

rules.label: Current HP
rules.description: Edit actual current HP immediately. This is different from adjusting Maximum HP or a temporary maximum-HP bonus.

rules.label: Mission title
rules.description: Name displayed on this mission card and in the player log.

rules.label: Mission type
rules.description: Reusable classification providing this mission’s default icon/background.

rules.label: Mission location
rules.description: Free-text location shown on the mission. This does not move tokens or change scenes.

rules.label: Reward distribution mode
rules.description: Split divides the listed quantity among recipients with random remainder allocation. Copy gives the full listed quantity to each eligible assigned character.

rules.label: Mission card image
rules.description: Optional per-mission background override; blank uses its mission type default.

rules.label: Mission description
rules.description: Player-facing mission text. Objectives, visibility and reward grants have separate controls.

rules.label: Current Stage
rules.description: Which saved stage is currently active. Each stage has its own title and objectives.

rules.label: Objective text
rules.description: Instructions for this objective in the selected mission stage.

rules.label: Hidden objective
rules.description: Conceal this objective until revealed under the player-log visibility rules. This does not hide the whole mission.

rules.label: Revealed objective
rules.description: Reveal the text of a hidden objective. This is separate from its completion flag.

rules.label: Done
rules.description: Record this objective’s completion. Mission completion and reward distribution remain separate actions.

rules.label: Reward quantity
rules.description: Count of this Item to split among recipients or copy per recipient, according to Reward Mode.

rules.label: Reward rarity
rules.description: Configured visual rarity/sort treatment. It does not multiply the reward quantity.

rules.label: Recipe name
rules.description: Display label for this recipe and its unlock card.

rules.label: Recipe card artwork
rules.description: Art for the recipe/card, separate from the output Item’s own art.

rules.label: Classification
rules.description: Category used to organize/filter this recipe without changing its ingredients.

rules.label: Recipe description
rules.description: Explanation for players. Ingredient/output Item references and quantities define the actual crafting exchange.

rules.label: Mission recipient
rules.description: Assign this character to the mission. Ownership/reward eligibility is checked separately when distributing Items.

rules.label: Stage title
rules.description: Name of the selected mission stage, independent of the mission’s overall title.

rules.label: Ingredient quantity
rules.description: Number of this ingredient needed for one craft. Crafting multiple copies multiplies the requirement.

rules.label: Crafted output quantity
rules.description: Number of output Items produced by one successful craft, separate from ingredient counts.

rules.label: Party access
rules.description: Allow party members who have unlocked this recipe to see/craft it. Existing unlocks are retained.

rules.label: Search recipes

rules.description: Manage reusable Path IDs, names, icons and colors.

rules.label: Eidolon Configuration
rules.description: Configure shared Eidolon background and glass layers.

rules.label: Help Documentation
rules.description: Open the searchable illustrated manual, index and complete field reference. Reading it is read-only.

rules.label: Mission Log
rules.description: Read accessible mission stages and objectives.

rules.label: Main Character
rules.description: Select an owned main character for this user.

rules.label: Ability Bubbles
rules.description: Show the normal ability widget workflows.

rules.label: Synthesize
rules.description: Open available learned recipes and the live crafting workflow.

rules.label: Eidolons
rules.description: Inspect the relevant Eidolon effects and unlock interface.

rules.label: Characters
rules.description: Select/manage the prioritized main character through its supported selector.

rules.label: GM Panel
rules.description: Open live GM resources and configuration launchers.

rules.label: DM Combat
rules.description: Open the encounter control panel.

rules.label: Mission Manager
rules.description: Prepare and edit campaign missions as GM.

rules.label: Configure Phone
rules.description: Edit the current profile’s launcher layout, wallpaper and pose.

rules.label: Configure Contacts
rules.description: Set which characters appear on player contact lists.

rules.label: Messenger
rules.description: Read conversations and deliberately send messages as the selected character.

rules.label: Inventory
rules.description: Open the selected main character’s inventory.

rules.label: Check Kit
rules.description: Inspect the current character’s configured kit. This does not cast its abilities.

rules.label: Character Sheet
rules.description: Open the configured Actor sheet tab or CSS element.

rules.label: Aha initiative preview
rules.description: Drag the artwork to crop; scroll to zoom. Its sample numeral does not set live Aha initiative.

rules.label: Boss bar preview
rules.description: Preview this phase’s portrait crop and inherited boss-bar layout. This does not change phase, HP or token size.

rules.label: Combat portrait preview
rules.description: Drop art, drag to crop and scroll to zoom the portrait for the combat lineup.

rules.label: Ultimate artwork preview
rules.description: Arrange the ordinary orb artwork. Alternate components use their independent canvas.

rules.label: Token transition preview
rules.description: Arrange the temporary enhanced-switch overlay; resulting token artwork is configured separately.

rules.label: Messenger portrait preview
rules.description: Crop the character’s circular chat identity image independently of its other portrait slots.

rules.label: Phone pose preview
rules.description: Drag the illustration to place it and scroll to zoom. This is the current phone profile’s visual layout.

rules.label: Phone wallpaper preview
rules.description: Inspect the current profile’s wallpaper fit, crop and zoom. This does not alter other profiles until their explicit save/apply actions.

rules.label: Circular charge
rules.description: Live cumulative circular count; its first activation offset and component sequence determine which icons are lit.

rules.label: Adjust circular charge
rules.description: Increase/decrease live circular charge by the indicated step. All prior sequence icons remain lit as charge increases.

rules.label: Preview counter
rules.description: Draft-only circular counter for examining the sequence. Live charge remains unchanged.

rules.label: Adjust preview counter
rules.description: Change only the draft circular preview count, without changing the Actor’s saved progress.

rules.label: Toggle preview component
rules.description: Change this individual component’s preview state without changing its live free-mode checkbox.

rules.label: Browse component images
rules.description: Choose images to add to the draft orb as new components.

rules.label: Change drawing layer
rules.description: Move this component in drawing order. Circular activation Sequence order is configured separately.

rules.label: Copy orb configuration
rules.description: Copy the regular saved alternate design to the enhanced form, retaining independent editing and live progress.

rules.label: Orb configuration
rules.description: Edit this named draft orb setting. Save orb design commits it; live progress uses its separate GM controls.

rules.label: Overall active glow
rules.description: Enable glow for active components, subject to each component’s own glow setting and color.

rules.label: Add existing Actor
rules.description: Select an existing world Actor to add as a summon choice. Duplicate references are avoided; use Count for multiple copies.

rules.label: Open summon source
rules.description: Open the referenced creature’s Actor sheet to inspect its prototype token size and kit. This does not place a token.

rules.label: Ally HP-cost consent
rules.description: Allow supported Light Cone ally HP-cost interactions for this Actor. This is separate from its own Skill HP requirement.

rules.label: Remove tracked condition
rules.description: Clear this tracked debuff mark without undoing already applied damage or removing unrelated effects.

rules.label: Ability category
rules.description: Classify this Item for supported cone rules: basic, enhanced basic, skill, ultimate, follow-up, Elation or Break.

rules.label: Memosprite owner
rules.description: Associate this creature with its summoner for supported Light Cone rules. This does not itself place or control a companion token.

rules.label: HP sacrifice option
rules.description: Choose Disabled, 2 HP or 4 HP for the supported cone’s configured sacrifice interaction.

rules.label: Trailblazer gate
rules.description: Choose the Actor used by the relevant cone’s configured Trailblazer gate; blank means not configured.

rules.label: Break partner
rules.description: Choose the relevant partner Actor, or let the supported cone use the highest Break Effect ally.

rules.label: Reset adjusted stat
rules.description: Clear this value’s manual combat adjustment and restore its automatic sheet + Planar + Light Cone baseline.

rules.label: Reset all combat changes
rules.description: Clear this character’s manual combat adjustments, restoring supported automatic baselines. Other characters are unaffected.

rules.label: Charging color
rules.description: Text form of this Element’s orb color before the Ultimate is ready. Use a CSS color value matching its linked picker.

rules.label: Ready color
rules.description: Text form of this Element’s fully charged Ultimate color. This changes presentation, not its weakness ID.

rules.label: Remove Element
rules.description: Remove this reusable Element definition from the editor. Check existing Actor/weakness references to its ID before saving.

rules.label: Add Element
rules.description: Add a reusable Element entry with a stable ID, display name, icon and charge/ready colors.

rules.label: Remove Path
rules.description: Remove this Path definition from the editor; check existing Actor and equipment references before saving.

rules.label: Add Path
rules.description: Add a reusable Path with stable identifier, name, icon and presentation color.

rules.label: Search missions
rules.description: Filter missions by name, location or type. This changes only the GM browser view, not mission visibility or completion.

rules.label: Mission status filter
rules.description: Show all, active, hidden, completed/rewards-pending or archived missions without changing their saved states.

rules.label: Adjust craft count
rules.description: Increase/decrease the number of requested crafts by the indicated step. Ingredients and output quantities scale with the craft count.

rules.label: Receiving character
rules.description: Character who receives the recipe/unlock card in this supported grant workflow. Selecting a recipient alone does not create or send the Item.

rules.label: Shrink combat HUD
rules.description: Reduce the local party HUD display scale without changing token size or character statistics.

rules.label: Enlarge combat HUD
rules.description: Increase the local party HUD display scale, not the mechanical footprint of map tokens.

rules.label: Minimize combat HUD
rules.description: Collapse the local party HUD display while retaining character configuration and charge.

rules.label: Use Ultimate
rules.description: Request this Actor’s active-form Ultimate through normal ownership, readiness, charge, summon and combat checks. Drag to the hotbar to create its macro.

rules.label: Change Element now
rules.description: GM only: choose this row’s current HSR Element and save immediately. Requires Multitype? ON and Type Changer. PCs, NPCs and summons are supported. A Scene token row affects that unlinked token Actor; a world Actor change is shared by its linked tokens. Future attacks and supported Element visuals update; already captured rolls keep their Element. None clears the Element.

rules.label: Change Actor Element
rules.description: GM only: choose this row’s current HSR Element and save immediately. Requires Multitype? ON and Type Changer. PCs, NPCs and summons are supported. A Scene token row affects that unlinked token Actor; a world Actor change is shared by its linked tokens. Future attacks and supported Element visuals update; already captured rolls keep their Element. None clears the Element.

rules.label: Change Actor Element
rules.description: GM only: choose this row’s current HSR Element and save immediately. Requires Multitype? ON and Type Changer. PCs, NPCs and summons are supported. A Scene token row affects that unlinked token Actor; a world Actor change is shared by its linked tokens. Future attacks and supported Element visuals update; already captured rolls keep their Element. None clears the Element.

rules.label: Element Change tab
rules.description: Show live Element controls for configured Type Changers: PCs, NPCs and summoned/token Actors. Enable Multitype? and Type Changer in that specific Actor’s HSR Element Settings first. Choosing an Element in a row saves immediately.

rules.label: Assign attack Elements
rules.description: Open this Actor’s owned Items and activities. Set a default HSR Element on an Item or override one activity. Each selection saves immediately. Blank activities inherit the Item, then Actor. Assignments affect Toughness when Multitype? uses Multitype attacks; Type Changer retains them for later.

rules.label: HSR Element Settings
rules.description: Open Assigned Element, Multitype? and its two modes for this exact Actor. Available to the GM for every PC, NPC and summon. Open an unlinked token’s own sheet to configure that token independently; linked tokens use their shared world Actor.

rules.label: HSR Attack Elements
rules.description: Open Element assignments for this owned Item and its activities. Item defaults inherit the Actor; an activity can override the Item. Actor owners and GMs may edit these saved selections. Enable Multitype? → Multitype attacks on the Actor to use them for Toughness.

rules.label: Multitype attacks mode
rules.description: Mode switch OFF: each attack resolves activity override → Item override → Actor Element. Assignments are independent, so an Ice spell and Lightning weapon activity can belong to the same Fire Actor.

rules.label: Type Changer mode
rules.description: Mode switch ON: the GM changes the Actor’s live Assigned Element from its sheet, Star Rail GM Panel or DM Combat → Element Change. All new attacks use that Element while this mode is active.

rules.label: Element settings save status
rules.description: Confirms a live Element/mode save or describes an error. A failed save restores the previously stored controls, so the displayed switch reflects the Actor’s saved configuration.

rules.label: HSR Element for this Item or activity
rules.description: Select one HSR Element for this attack. The Item row is its default; an activity row overrides only that activity. Inherit Item / Actor uses the next parent’s choice. Changes save immediately and affect new rolls when Multitype attacks is active; D&D5e damage types, formulas and resistances are unchanged.

rules.label: Item Element
rules.description: Default HSR Element for this owned Item. Every activity without a specific override inherits it. Inherit Actor uses the Actor’s current Assigned Element. Saves immediately. This selection does not change the Actor’s own Element.

rules.label: Find an Item or activity
rules.description: Filter this Actor’s list by Item and activity names. Multiple words narrow the results. Filtering only changes this local editor view; it does not change or erase any saved Element assignment.

rules.label: Attack Element save status
rules.description: Confirms the most recent Item/activity Element save. An error restores the previous dropdown selection. Choices persist on owned Items and remain stored when Multitype is disabled or Type Changer is selected.

rules.label: Configure Toughness
rules.description: Open this Actor’s current/max Toughness, weaknesses, NPC allegiance and initiative artwork. The dialog also provides a Multitype & Elements shortcut. Available on actual NPC and PC Actor sheets.

rules.label: Configure Multitype and Elements
rules.description: Enable Multitype? on this exact PC, NPC or summoned Actor. Choose independent Item/activity attack Elements or live Type Changer. The same configuration is available from the Toughness dialog.

rules.label: Configure Boss Encounter
rules.description: Open this Actor’s HSR settings, including boss phases, linked phase Actors, token sizes and boss HUD artwork. This opens configuration without starting a phase change.

rules.label: Planar Relics
rules.description: Open the installed Planar module from a compact Actor-header icon. PC sheets open that character’s equipment, upgrades and set details. On NPC sheets the GM opens global set, currency and material configuration. Spell/Activity windows do not receive this Actor control.

rules.label: Original / Buffed stats
rules.description: Switch this PC sheet between editable original scores and the read-only values after Planar bonuses. The icon tooltip names the current view; selecting a view does not rewrite the underlying original statistics.

rules.label: NPC Enemy / Ally
rules.description: GM only. ON selects Ally: hide this NPC’s map/boss Toughness bar and weakness display, disable Toughness processing and use a blue initiative card. OFF selects Enemy: enable Toughness and use red. Saves immediately; retains current/max Toughness, weaknesses, HP and Ultimate/Multitype settings. A saved choice overrides old frame colors and token disposition. Unlinked/summoned token Actors change independently.

rules.label: NPC Enemy / Ally
rules.description: GM only. ON selects Ally: hide this NPC’s map/boss Toughness bar and weakness display, disable Toughness processing and use a blue initiative card. OFF selects Enemy: enable Toughness and use red. Saves immediately; retains current/max Toughness, weaknesses, HP and Ultimate/Multitype settings. A saved choice overrides old frame colors and token disposition. Unlinked/summoned token Actors change independently.

rules.label: Ally mode
rules.description: Switch ON selects Ally: the NPC uses a blue initiative frame and has no Toughness bar or Toughness reduction. Saved weakness and Toughness values remain available for a later return to Enemy.

rules.label: Enemy mode
rules.description: Switch OFF selects Enemy: the NPC uses a red initiative frame and Toughness is enabled. This takes priority over an older custom frame color.

rules.label: Ally mode
rules.description: Switch ON hides this NPC’s Toughness and uses a blue initiative frame; stored current/max and weakness values are retained.

rules.label: Enemy mode
rules.description: Switch OFF enables this NPC’s Toughness and uses a red initiative frame. The switch saves immediately.

rules.label: Multitype & Elements
rules.description: Open the same Actor’s Multitype? toggle, Multitype attacks / Type Changer switch and current HSR Element. This shortcut is also available as the shuffle icon beside Configure Toughness.

rules.label: Format Initiative Portrait
rules.description: GM only. Open the drag, zoom and flip editor for this NPC’s initiative tracker picture. Edits save to the source NPC and apply to its existing and future Ally/Enemy copies across scenes; portrait edits do not change allegiance, HP or Toughness.

rules.label: Format Initiative Portrait
rules.description: Open the shared NPC initiative picture editor. Browse/drop artwork, drag to reposition, scroll to zoom and toggle Flip. Portrait edits save immediately, separately from the Toughness dialog’s Save button.

rules.label: Shared NPC framing source
rules.description: Names the source world NPC that receives portrait edits. Its existing and future token copies, including unlinked summons across scenes, use the same framing. Duplicated configured world Actors retain the source reference. Unlinked copies retain separate allegiance, HP, Toughness and stance; linked tokens continue to share their Actor’s combat state.

rules.label: Initiative artwork preview
rules.description: Drop an accessible image into this preview to replace the tracker portrait. Drag the card to reposition the artwork and scroll to zoom. The preview uses the tracker’s crop and flip. Every change saves automatically; for NPCs the artwork is shared by copies of the same source.

rules.label: Portrait save status
rules.description: Unsaved changes waits briefly before saving; Saving means a write is in progress. Saved confirms the artwork was stored. Save failed means the previous stored framing is still active; check permissions or retry an edit. Closing flushes pending changes.

rules.label: Open spell
rules.description: Inspect the selected compendium spell without casting it or spending resources. Disabled until a source spell has been dropped.

rules.label: Clear spell
rules.description: Clear the Other source reference. This does not delete the compendium spell or an already imported character-owned copy. Disabled without a source selection.

rules.label: Casts spell?
rules.description: After the Skill pays its configured SP/actual HP costs, cast a real owned spell as this character. Cancelled or blocked casting refunds those costs. OFF keeps the normal descriptive Skill.

rules.label: Spell source: Spell known / Other
rules.description: Flip OFF for Spell known, which selects an existing character spell. Flip ON for Other, which accepts a compendium spell by drag and drop. Both saved choices are retained when switching; this switch saves immediately.

rules.label: Spell known
rules.description: Choose a spell Item already owned by this character. The Skill uses its native spell activity with the character as caster. Removing that spell requires selecting another one.

rules.label: Other: compendium spell
rules.description: Drop a spell Item from a compendium. The first cast imports an owned copy onto this character; subsequent casts reuse it. Actors, features and world Items are rejected. The source compendium is unchanged.

rules.label: Position character
rules.description: Choose this position’s world character. Choosing a member already in another position swaps the two slots. Active player characters and GM-locked members cannot be removed by players.

rules.label: Lock in shared lineup
rules.description: Save the four positions for all clients and apply their order to the combat party HUD. Missing required characters, protected members or a stale draft prevent the save.

rules.label: Swap slots
rules.description: Swap your active character with the chosen position, preserving both party members. The GM can choose any two positions. Lock in changes applies the draft to everyone.

rules.label: Swap from position
rules.description: GM only: choose the first of two positions to exchange. Swapping changes the draft until Lock in changes is pressed.

rules.label: Swap with position
rules.description: Choose the position to exchange with your active character, or with the GM’s selected source position. Both characters stay in the lineup.

rules.label: Reload current party
rules.description: Replace the local draft with the latest shared lineup and requirements. Use this after another client has saved a change.

rules.label: Enforce Party Requires
rules.description: GM only: enable or disable the stored required-character list. Save Party Requires applies the toggle; turning it off keeps the list for later.

rules.label: Required character sheet
rules.description: GM only: drag a world character Actor into this position. Up to four different exact characters can be required; NPCs, Items and compendium entries are rejected.

rules.label: Remove required character
rules.description: GM only: remove this character from the draft requirement list. Save Party Requires applies the change.

rules.label: Save Party Requires
rules.description: Apply the GM’s required-character list and on/off toggle without locking a new lineup. A separately edited lineup draft is preserved.

rules.label: Configure four-position artwork
rules.description: GM only: open four independent image settings for a character. Position 1–4 each selects its own artwork whenever that character occupies the matching slot.

rules.label: Artwork character
rules.description: Choose the world character whose four position images you want to edit. Each character has independent image paths and framing.

rules.label: Position artwork path
rules.description: Choose the image for this character in this specific party position. An empty path uses the character portrait. The other three positions retain their own artwork.

rules.label: Position artwork alignment
rules.description: Align the image inside this position’s preview, from 0 to 100 percent on each axis. This changes party artwork framing only.

rules.label: Position artwork scale
rules.description: Scale this position’s image from 25 to 250 percent. Save the character’s artwork to share the new framing with the party.

rules.label: Flip position artwork
rules.description: Mirror this position’s character image horizontally. Each of the four variants has its own flip setting.

rules.label: Browse position artwork
rules.description: Choose or upload an image through Foundry storage for this character’s selected position. The other position images are unchanged.

rules.label: Drop position artwork
rules.description: Drop an uploaded image path or an Actor or Item to use its image in this specific position. Save artwork applies the four character variants.

rules.label: Save character position artwork
rules.description: Save all four image paths, alignments, scales and flip settings for this character. Clients use the matching artwork when the character moves between party positions.

rules.label: Open shared Party Setup
rules.description: Open the communal four-position lineup, slot swapping and GM-required character list. Saved positions determine combat HUD order for all clients.

rules.label: Shared Party Setup
rules.description: Open the communal four-position party lineup. Saved positions determine the combat HUD order for everyone; players keep their active characters and the GM can require specific members.
